# Code Anchors: Published Package

- `package.json` — the published manifest: the owner-scoped name, one declared binary, one engine floor, the supported platforms, and the files allowlist that alone defines what ships.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/pack-release.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/pack-release.spec.ts` — staging every published part into one directory at the package root, re-run as part of packing so no stale or empty tree can ship.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.spec.ts` — the stated set the allowlist admits, and the payload manifest and fingerprint regenerated with it.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/build-bundles.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/build-bundles.spec.ts` — one self-contained artifact per declared binary name, with no runtime dependencies.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/entry-point.ts` — the direct-run test comparing fully resolved real paths, because a linked binary's name never matches as a string.
- `libs/release-identity/src/release.ts`, `libs/release-identity/src/release.spec.ts` — the single version declaration every staged part walks up to find.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/allowlist.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/allowlist-docs.spec.ts` — the permission grant that tracks the declared binary count, held byte-identical across three surfaces.
- `README.md` — the adopter-facing requirements, install steps and permission grant carrying the same declarations.
- `docs/delivery/release-procedure.md` — the procedure that packs, verifies and publishes this manifest.
